programmes.name_en: Rent Benefit (rent allowance for low-income tenants)
programmes.amount_note: Income-dependent contribution to rent; since 2026 no maximum-rent condition and servicekosten no longer count; calculation rent capped at EUR 932.93/month (EUR 498.20 for 18-20 yr); no fixed income ceiling - benefit tapers to zero.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply up to and including 31 December of the year after the benefit year (Dienst Toeslagen). Benefit starts on the 1st of the month you are registered at the address.

procedure_steps.detail: Check conditions and make a proefberekening (trial calculation) on belastingdienst.nl
Apply via Mijn toeslagen with DigiD

documents_required.doc: Income details of applicant, toeslagpartner and medebewoners

eligibility.income_note: Dienst Toeslagen publishes no single income ceiling for huurtoeslag. The conditions page states only that your income and that of your toeslagpartner and medebewoners must not be too high, and refers you to a proefberekening; the cut-off depends on rent, age and household composition. From 2026 the maximum rent limit is abolished, service costs no longer count, and the young-person rent rule applies only up to age 21 instead of 23.

programmes.source_snippet: U, uw toeslagpartner en medebewoners van 18 jaar en ouder hebben de Nederlandse nationaliteit of zijn legaal in Nederland. U bent 18 jaar of ouder. Tot en met 2025 gold nog een maximale huurgrens.

programmes.name_en: Healthcare Benefit (contribution to health insurance premium)
programmes.amount_note: 2026 maximum EUR 129/month for a single person (EUR 246/month for you and a toeslagpartner together); amount tapers with income, zero above EUR 40,857 (single) / EUR 51,142 (with partner). Assets must not exceed EUR 146,011 (EUR 184,633 with partner) on 1 Jan 2026.

procedure_steps.detail: Check income limits on belastingdienst.nl
Apply via Mijn toeslagen with DigiD

eligibility.income_note: 2026 limit: EUR 40,857 toetsingsinkomen without toeslagpartner; EUR 51,142 combined with a toeslagpartner (the stored figure is the single-person limit).

programmes.source_snippet: U kunt in 2026 zorgtoeslag krijgen als uw jaarinkomen niet boven de grens van € 40.857 uitkomt. Hebt u in 2026 een toeslagpartner? Dan mag het inkomen van u allebei samen niet meer dan € 51.142 zijn.

programmes.name_en: Child Budget (income-tested child supplement on top of kinderbijslag)
programmes.amount_note: Depends on income, number and age of children. Assets limit 2026: EUR 146,011 (single) / EUR 184,633 (with toeslagpartner), tested on 1 January. Requires receiving kinderbijslag from SVB (not always for 16-17 year olds).

procedure_steps.detail: Ensure you receive kinderbijslag from SVB
Check and apply via Mijn toeslagen (often offered automatically after kinderbijslag is granted)

eligibility.income_note: Income- and asset-tested but no single fixed ceiling: full amount up to toetsingsinkomen EUR 29,736 (single parent) / EUR 39,141 (with toeslagpartner) in 2026; above that reduced by 7.6% of the excess, so the cut-off depends on number/age of children. Asset cap 2026: EUR 146,011 (no partner) / EUR 184,633 (partner).

programmes.source_snippet: U hebt 1 of meer kinderen die jonger zijn dan 18 jaar. U krijgt kinderbijslag van de Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB). Uw (gezamenlijke) inkomen is niet te hoog. Uw (gezamenlijke) vermogen is niet te hoog.

programmes.name_en: Child Benefit (universal quarterly child allowance)
programmes.amount_note: Per child. SVB pays quarterly: from Q3 2026 EUR 298.40 (age 0-5), EUR 362.35 (6-11), EUR 426.29 (12-17) per quarter; annual figures shown are 4 x these. Not income-tested.
programmes.deadline_note: Usually arranged automatically after registering the birth at the gemeente; otherwise apply via Mijn SVB.

procedure_steps.detail: Register the birth of your child at the gemeente
SVB contacts you and pays quarterly; manage via Mijn SVB

eligibility.income_note: No income or asset test

programmes.source_snippet: De kinderbijslagbedragen zijn per kind per kwartaal. Vanaf het derde kwartaal van 2026 gaat de kinderbijslag omhoog. 0 tot en met 5 jaar € 298,40; 6 tot en met 11 jaar € 362,35; 12 tot en met 17 jaar € 426,29.

programmes.name_en: Childcare Benefit (reimbursement of registered childcare costs)
programmes.amount_note: Share of childcare costs up to a maximum hourly price (2026: EUR 11.23, EUR 9.98 or EUR 8.49 depending on type of care). Parents with joint income up to EUR 56,413 receive 96% of the maximum hourly price. You always pay an own contribution; registered (LRK) care required.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply as soon as the childcare contract is signed; at the latest within 3 months after care starts, otherwise you lose money.

procedure_steps.detail: Arrange childcare at a geregistreerde kinderopvang (LRK-registered)
Apply via Mijn toeslagen with DigiD, using the childcare contract

documents_required.doc: Income details of applicant and toeslagpartner

eligibility.income_note: No income ceiling: kinderopvangtoeslag tapers but never stops. Dienst Toeslagen states that in 2026 parents with a joint income up to EUR 56,413 are reimbursed 96% of the maximum hourly price, and higher incomes receive a larger share of the maximum hourly price than in 2025. Maximum hourly prices in 2026: EUR 11.23 day care, EUR 9.98 out-of-school care, EUR 8.49 childminder care.

programmes.source_snippet: Vraag uw kinderopvangtoeslag zo snel mogelijk aan. Dit kan al zodra u het contract met de opvang hebt getekend. Doe dit uiterlijk binnen 3 maanden nadat de opvang is gestart. Anders loopt u geld mis.

programmes.name_en: Social Assistance Benefit (minimum income support via municipality)
programmes.amount_note: Bijstandsnorm per 1 July 2026 (net, excl. holiday pay detail): single 21-AOW age EUR 1,419.46/month; married/cohabiting EUR 2,027.79/month; from AOW age EUR 1,587.34 (single) / EUR 2,176.10 (couple). Lower norms below age 21.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply from 4 weeks before you need it; gemeente decides within 8 weeks.

procedure_steps.detail: Register as jobseeker at werk.nl if able to work
Apply for bijstand at your gemeente with DigiD
Cooperate with the intake interview and re-integration obligations

eligibility.income_note: Annualised bijstandsnorm for a single adult: EUR 1,419.46 x 12 = EUR 17,034 (from 1 July 2026). Couple norm EUR 2,027.79 x 12 = EUR 24,333. Assets also tested.

programmes.source_snippet: Alleenstaande 21 jaar tot AOW-leeftijd: € 1401,50 per 1 januari 2026, € 1419,46 per 1 juli 2026. Getrouwd of samenwonend 21 jaar tot AOW-leeftijd: € 2002,13 / € 2027,79.

programmes.name_en: Special Assistance (one-off municipal payment for exceptional necessary costs)
programmes.amount_note: Payment (gift or interest-free loan, depending on municipality) for necessary, exceptional costs you cannot pay yourself, e.g. replacing a broken washing machine or legal-aid own contribution.
programmes.deadline_note: Always apply BEFORE incurring the costs; gemeente decides within 8 weeks.

procedure_steps.detail: Check whether the cost qualifies and no other scheme covers it
Request the application form from your gemeente and submit with evidence

documents_required.doc: Offerte of factuur van de kosten

eligibility.income_note: Income below the municipal threshold, typically 100-110% of the bijstandsnorm (some municipalities use up to 130-150%). 110% = EUR 1,561.41/month single incl. vakantietoeslag (Jul 2026) = EUR 18,737/yr (conversion: 12 x monthly norm). Participatiewet asset limits apply (EUR 8,000 single / EUR 16,000 couple or single parent).

programmes.source_snippet: U heeft mogelijk recht op bijzondere bijstand als u onder andere voldoet aan de volgende voorwaarden: u woont rechtmatig in Nederland; u heeft onvoldoende inkomen en vermogen om de kosten zelf te betalen; u bent 18 jaar of ouder.

programmes.name_local: Uitkering IOAW (Inkomensvoorziening oudere en gedeeltelijk arbeidsongeschikte werkloze werknemers)
programmes.name_en: IOAW Benefit (bridge benefit for older unemployed persons)
programmes.amount_note: Benefit up to bijstandsnorm level for people who became unemployed at 50 or older and whose WW ended; until AOW age.

procedure_steps.detail: Check whether your WW-uitkering is ending and you meet the age rule
Apply at UWV via uwv.nl or by phone

eligibility.income_note: Income-tested against the bijstandsnorm (EUR 1,419.46/month single from 1 July 2026 = EUR 17,034/yr). Only for people born before 1 January 1965 who became unemployed after age 50.

programmes.source_snippet: U kunt in aanmerking komen voor een IOAW-uitkering als u bent geboren vóór 1 januari 1965. En als u na uw 50e jaar werkloos bent geworden.

programmes.name_local: Uitkering IOAZ (Inkomensvoorziening oudere en gedeeltelijk arbeidsongeschikte gewezen zelfstandigen)
programmes.name_en: IOAZ Benefit (bridge benefit for older former self-employed persons)
programmes.amount_note: Benefit up to bijstandsnorm level for former self-employed persons aged 55+ whose business ended; until AOW age.

procedure_steps.detail: Check eligibility as gewezen zelfstandige aged 55+
Apply at UWV via uwv.nl or by phone

eligibility.income_note: IOAZ tops up income to about the bijstandsnorm; no benefit once own income reaches the norm (single norm EUR 17,034/yr in 2026, 12 x EUR 1,419.46/month). No asset test.

programmes.source_snippet: Voor mensen die op oudere leeftijd werkloos worden bestaat na hun werkloosheidsuitkering een IOAW of IOW-uitkering. Voor zelfstandigen van 55 jaar of ouder ...

programmes.name_en: State Pension (AOW)
programmes.amount_note: Gross per month from 1 July 2026, full AOW: EUR 1,662.16 if you live alone; EUR 1,139.39 per person if married/cohabiting. Plus holiday pay (EUR 104.78 / EUR 74.85 per month, paid in May). AOW builds up 2% per year lived/insured in NL between age 15 and AOW age.
programmes.deadline_note: SVB usually invites you about 4-6 months before you reach AOW age; if not, apply via Mijn SVB.

procedure_steps.detail: Wait for the SVB invitation letter or apply yourself via Mijn SVB with DigiD
Provide bank account and marital status details

eligibility.income_note: No income test; amount reduced if you lived outside the Netherlands during build-up years; AOW age is 67 in 2026

programmes.source_snippet: AOW bedragen vanaf 1 juli 2026. U woont alleen: Brutobedrag AOW € 1.662,16. U bent getrouwd of woont samen: Brutobedrag AOW € 1.139,39 per persoon.

programmes.name_en: Supplementary Income Provision for the Elderly (tops up low AOW to social minimum)
programmes.amount_note: Maximum AIO supplement per month (excl. holiday pay): EUR 1,507.97 if you live alone; EUR 2,067.29 for a couple together. Holiday pay adds EUR 79.37 / EUR 108.81 per month. AIO tops up income to the social minimum if the AOW is incomplete; assets are tested.

procedure_steps.detail: Check your total income against the bijstandsnorm
Apply via Mijn SVB with DigiD

eligibility.income_note: Single norm incl. holiday pay EUR 1,587.34/month x 12 = EUR 19,048 (1 July 2026); couple EUR 2,176.10 x 12 = EUR 26,113.

programmes.source_snippet: U woont alleen: Bedrag € 1.507,97, Vakantiegeld € 79,37, Totaal € 1.587,34. U woont met uw partner: Bedrag € 2.067,29, Vakantiegeld € 108,81, Totaal € 2.176,10.

programmes.name_en: Survivor's Benefit (benefit for widows/widowers and orphans)
programmes.amount_note: Maximum gross EUR 1,698.30/month. Earned income is partly deducted: the first EUR 1,635.90 gross is ignored, income above that reduces the benefit by two thirds.

procedure_steps.detail: Report the death to the gemeente (aangifte overlijden)
Apply for Anw at SVB via Mijn SVB

eligibility.income_note: No hard income ceiling; benefit is reduced by two thirds of gross income above EUR 1,635.90/month.

programmes.source_snippet: Zorgt u voor een kind jonger dan 18 jaar dat bij u thuis woont? U kunt een nabestaandenuitkering krijgen als uw partner op de dag van overlijden verzekerd was voor de Anw. Anders: minimaal 45% arbeidsongeschikt.

programmes.name_en: Individual Income Supplement (annual top-up for long-term benefit recipients)
programmes.amount_note: Annual payment (a few hundred euros) for people who have received a social security benefit (bijstand, WIA, WAO, Wajong, WW-related) for a long period; paid automatically, usually in January.
programmes.deadline_note: No application needed; paid automatically by the institution paying your benefit if you meet the conditions.

procedure_steps.detail: No action required; payment is automatic if eligible

eligibility.income_note: For people who have lived at or below the bijstandsnorm for at least 3 years (broadly; municipalities may apply up to 110%). Bijstandsnorm single 2026: EUR 1,419.46/month incl. vakantietoeslag = EUR 17,034/yr (12 x monthly).

programmes.source_snippet: u bent ouder dan 21 jaar, maar nog niet AOW-gerechtigd; u heeft geen of weinig inkomen en vermogen; De gemeente kan nog andere voorwaarden stellen, bijvoorbeeld dat u heeft geprobeerd uw inkomen te verhogen.

programmes.name_en: Unemployment Benefit
programmes.amount_note: 75% of last daily wage for the first 2 months, then 70% (capped at maximum dagloon); duration 3 to 24 months depending on employment history.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply from 1 week before until 1 week after your last working day, or you lose benefit days.

procedure_steps.detail: Register as werkzoekende at werk.nl (at the latest 1 week before unemployment)
Apply for WW at uwv.nl with DigiD, with arbeidscontract, laatste loonstrook and ontslagbrief
Submit monthly inkomstenopgave and meet sollicitatieplicht

eligibility.income_note: Not income- or asset-tested; requires wekeneis (26 of last 36 weeks worked) and not verwijtbaar werkloos

programmes.source_snippet: U heeft in de laatste 36 weken voordat u werkloos werd minstens 26 weken gewerkt. U werkte gemiddeld minimaal 10 uur per week en verliest 5 uur of meer van uw werk per week. U bent direct beschikbaar voor betaald werk.

programmes.name_en: Sickness Benefit (income during illness without employer wage payment)
programmes.amount_note: 70% of daily wage for max 2 years; for sick workers without (continued) employer wage payment, e.g. after end of temporary contract, flex workers, organ donors, no-riskpolis.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply no later than the second day of sickness.

procedure_steps.detail: Employer reports you ziek uit dienst at UWV (application is then automatic), or call UWV yourself by the 2nd sick day
UWV assesses and pays monthly

eligibility.income_note: For employees without wage continuation (e.g. end of contract while sick) and specific groups (flex, pregnancy, organ donation, no-riskpolis)

programmes.source_snippet: In sommige situaties krijgt de werknemer een Ziektewet-uitkering: werkt flexibel (uitzend-, oproep-, nul-urencontract), ziek door zwangerschap of bevalling, orgaandonatie, no-riskpolis. Aanvragen uiterlijk op de tweede ziektedag.

programmes.name_en: Work and Income according to Labour Capacity Benefit (disability benefit after 2 years of illness)
programmes.amount_note: IVA: 75% of former wage for 80-100% and durably disabled; WGA: wage-related then loonaanvullings-/vervolguitkering for 35-80% disabled.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply within 6 weeks of receiving the UWV letter near the end of your 2-year illness period.

procedure_steps.detail: Receive UWV letter before end of 104 weeks of illness
Apply for WIA within 6 weeks; attend keuring by verzekeringsarts and arbeidsdeskundige

eligibility.income_note: After 2 years of illness, still at least 35% arbeidsongeschikt; not asset-tested

programmes.source_snippet: Na bijna 2 jaar ziekte nog niet (helemaal) aan het werk? Kijk waar u recht op heeft in de wet Werk en Inkomen naar Arbeidsvermogen (WIA).

programmes.name_en: Disability Benefit for Young Disabled Persons
programmes.amount_note: 75% of the statutory minimum wage for those unable to work due to illness/disability arisen at or before age 18 (or before 30 while studying); plus annual supplementary payment.
programmes.deadline_note: You can apply from 6 months before your 18th birthday.

procedure_steps.detail: Request the 'beoordeling arbeidsvermogen' online at UWV (choose Wajong)
Attend assessment by verzekeringsarts/arbeidsdeskundige; UWV decides within 14 weeks

documents_required.doc: Medische bewijsstukken van ziekte of handicap
Bewijs dat de ziekte/handicap op of voor de 18e ontstond (bij latere aanvraag)

eligibility.income_note: Not asset-tested; requires inability to work now and in future; arose at/before 18, or before 30 with 6 months of prior study

programmes.source_snippet: U kreeg klachten op of voor uw 18e verjaardag. Of u kreeg klachten voor uw 30e en volgde minimaal 6 maanden een opleiding. U woonde in Nederland op het moment dat u aan de voorwaarden van Wajong voldeed.

programmes.name_en: WAO Disability Benefit (legacy scheme, existing beneficiaries)
programmes.amount_note: Legacy disability benefit for people who became unfit for work before 1 January 2004; closed to new applicants (replaced by WIA).
programmes.deadline_note: Closed to new claimants: WAO only exists for people who became ill before 1 January 2004.

procedure_steps.detail: Existing beneficiaries report changes in health/work to UWV

eligibility.income_note: Only for people already receiving WAO; percentage of former wage depending on disability class (15-100%)

programmes.source_snippet: De WAO-uitkering is er voor iemand die voor 1 januari 2004 ziek werd. En daardoor minder of niet kan werken.

programmes.name_en: Student Finance: Basic Grant
programmes.amount_note: Maximum per month in 2026. hbo/university: EUR 130.21 living with parents, EUR 324.52 living away. mbo (bol): EUR 107.26 / EUR 350.03. Basisbeurs is a performance grant (converted to gift if you graduate in time; a gift for mbo 1-2).
programmes.deadline_note: Apply at the latest on the last day of the first month of your programme to receive the grant from the start.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via Mijn DUO with DigiD
Register your bank account and activate the student travel product

eligibility.income_note: No parental income test for the basisbeurs; full-time mbo/hbo/university at a recognised institution

programmes.source_snippet: U bent Nederlander of u hebt een verblijfsvergunning type II, III, IV of V. U moet jonger zijn dan 30 als uw studiefinanciering ingaat. Doet u mbo? Dan moet u minimaal 18 jaar zijn voor een beurs of rentedragende lening.

programmes.name_en: Supplementary Grant (income-tested top-up to student finance)
programmes.amount_note: Maximum EUR 491.08/month for hbo/university in 2026; mbo maximum EUR 438.08-470.82 (varies by living situation and period). Depends on parents' income from two years ago and number of siblings studying.

procedure_steps.detail: Indicate in your studiefinanciering application in Mijn DUO that you want the aanvullende beurs
Parents confirm or DUO retrieves parental income (from 2 years earlier) automatically

eligibility.income_note: Based on parents' income from 2 years ago (and siblings); no single household ceiling published as one figure.

programmes.source_snippet: Maximale aanvullende beurs: Januari tot en met december 2026 € 491,08. Als uw ouders meer verdienen, kunt u vaak toch een (gedeeltelijke) aanvullende beurs krijgen.

programmes.name_en: Tuition Fee Loan (DUO loan covering statutory tuition fees)
programmes.amount_note: Statutory tuition fee 2026-27 is EUR 2,694, so the standard credit is 1/12 = EUR 224.50/month from September 2026 (EUR 216.75 until August 2026). With institutional (higher) tuition fee you can borrow more, up to 5 x the statutory fee = EUR 1,122.50/month. It is a loan with interest.

procedure_steps.detail: Request collegegeldkrediet via Mijn DUO (can be combined with basisbeurs)

eligibility.income_note: No income test; for students in bekostigde hbo/wo programmes paying wettelijk or instellingscollegegeld

programmes.source_snippet: Hebt u geen recht op studiefinanciering vanwege uw nationaliteit? Dan kunt u collegegeldkrediet krijgen als u aan de volgende voorwaarden voldoet: Uw opleiding duurt minimaal 1 jaar.

programmes.name_en: Student Travel Product (free or discounted public transport for students)
programmes.amount_note: Free travel either on weekdays or weekends (student's choice) on all Dutch public transport, with 40% discount in the complementary period; prestatiebeurs: gift if diploma within 10 years.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply for studiefinanciering in Mijn DUO
Pick up the studentenreisproduct at an NS card machine after linking your personal OV-chipkaart

eligibility.income_note: For students entitled to studiefinanciering in mbo/hbo/wo; maximum 5 years in higher education

programmes.source_snippet: U krijgt een studentenreisproduct als u een voltijdopleiding doet aan mbo, hbo of universiteit, ook als u nog geen 18 bent. Uw opleiding moet recht ...

programmes.name_en: School Pupils' Allowance (for 18+ pupils in secondary education from low-income families)
programmes.amount_note: Maximum aanvullende toelage per month, Aug-Dec 2026: vo onderbouw EUR 104.11, vo bovenbouw EUR 113.98, vso EUR 69.15, vavo EUR 152.47. Depends on parents' income.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via Mijn DUO with DigiD

eligibility.income_note: Basistoelage is not income-tested (2026: EUR 147.65/month thuiswonend, EUR 344.26 uitwonend, Jan-Jul 2026). The aanvullende toelage (max EUR 147/month, schooljaar 2025-2026) depends on the income of parent(s)/carer(s) from 2 years prior.

programmes.source_snippet: Aanvullende toelage maximaal bedrag augustus tot en met december 2026: Voortgezet onderwijs bovenbouw € 113,98; vavo € 152,47. U moet minimaal 18 jaar zijn. U moet jonger zijn dan 30 als uw tegemoetkoming ingaat.

programmes.name_en: Lifelong Learning Credit (DUO loan for tuition of adult learners)
programmes.amount_note: Low-interest DUO loan up to the annual collegegeld/leergeld per academic year for full-time, part-time or dual students aged up to 55 without regular studiefinanciering; still available in 2026 (STAP-budget ended 2023).
programmes.deadline_note: Apply before the academic year starts; available until age 55 (until 57 under conditions).

procedure_steps.detail: Check eligibility for your programme at duo.nl
Apply via Mijn DUO with DigiD before the deadline

eligibility.income_note: No income test (it is a loan); for students up to age 55 who are not entitled to regular studiefinanciering. Still open for applications in 2026.

programmes.source_snippet: Wilt u een opleiding volgen, maar hebt u geen recht meer op reguliere studiefinanciering? Als u jonger bent dan 57 jaar kunt u misschien toch geld lenen.

programmes.name_en: R&D Tax Credit (reduction of payroll tax for research & development)
programmes.amount_note: Tax scheme: S&O-afdrachtvermindering (reduction of wage tax/social premiums for R&D); starters receive 50% instead of 36% on the first bracket (per Handleiding WBSO 2026).
programmes.deadline_note: Applications for the 2026 calendar year closed on Wednesday 30 September 2026 (last possible date). Applications for the next year/period are made with eHerkenning (level 3, RVO-services).

procedure_steps.detail: Write a technical description of your S&O (R&D) project
Apply via the RVO eLoket with eHerkenning
Keep S&O hour administration and report realisation by 31 March after the year

eligibility.income_note: For companies liable to Dutch income or corporate tax doing technical-scientific R&D; self-employed need 1,225 total hours and 500 S&O hours per year

programmes.source_snippet: Let op: woensdag 30 september is de laatste mogelijkheid om een WBSO aanvraag in te dienen voor het jaar 2026.

programmes.name_en: Energy Investment Deduction (extra profit deduction for energy-saving business assets)
programmes.amount_note: Deduct 40% of the investment cost from taxable profit for investments on the Energielijst; unused deduction can be carried to other years.
programmes.deadline_note: Report the investment to RVO within 3 months after ordering.

procedure_steps.detail: Check that the asset is on the Energielijst
Report to RVO within 3 months via eLoket (eHerkenning)
Claim the EIA in your income or corporate tax return

eligibility.income_note: For entrepreneurs paying Dutch income or corporate tax; asset must be new, on the Energielijst, min EUR 2,500

programmes.source_snippet: Voor die investeringen kunt u 40% van de investeringskosten aftrekken van de fiscale winst.

programmes.name_en: Environmental Investment Deduction and Arbitrary Depreciation
programmes.amount_note: MIA: deduct up to 45% of the investment cost from profit. Vamil: depreciate up to 75% at a moment of your choice. Asset must be on the current Milieulijst; not for private individuals.
programmes.deadline_note: Report to RVO within 3 months after ordering.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the asset on the Milieulijst and its category code
Report to RVO within 3 months via eLoket
Claim in your tax return

eligibility.income_note: For entrepreneurs paying Dutch income or corporate tax investing in assets on the Milieulijst

programmes.source_snippet: Met de MIA kunt u voor uw investering tot 45% van de investeringskosten aftrekken van uw winst. Met Vamil kunt u tot 75% van uw investering afschrijven op een tijdstip dat u zelf bepaalt.

programmes.name_en: SME Credit Guarantee Scheme (state guarantee on business loans)
programmes.amount_note: Government guarantee of 90% on the bank loan (BMKB). Companies up to 250 FTE with turnover up to EUR 50 million or balance sheet up to EUR 43 million; sole traders and partnerships qualify. You apply through your financier, not directly.
programmes.deadline_note: Scheme open for applications (via financiers) until 1 July 2027.

procedure_steps.detail: Ask your bank for a business loan; the bank applies for the BMKB guarantee at RVO
Provide business plan and financials to the bank

eligibility.income_note: For SMEs (max 250 employees) in the Netherlands needing credit without sufficient collateral

programmes.source_snippet: Op het BMKB-krediet is een overheidsborgstelling van 90% van toepassing. Aanvragen tot 1 juli 2027. Bedrijven vragen niet zelf aan. Dit gaat via financiers.

programmes.name_en: Self-employed Deduction and Starter's Deduction (income tax deductions for entrepreneurs)
programmes.amount_note: 2026: zelfstandigenaftrek EUR 1,200 (limited to profit); startersaftrek EUR 2,123 on top (total EUR 3,323 for starters). Requires meeting the hours criterion.
programmes.deadline_note: Claimed in the annual income tax return (aangifte inkomstenbelasting).

procedure_steps.detail: Meet the urencriterium (1,225 hours per year in your business)
Claim the deduction in your income tax return

eligibility.income_note: For income tax entrepreneurs meeting the hour criterion; startersaftrek additional for new businesses

programmes.source_snippet: Dan is de zelfstandigenaftrek in 2026 een bedrag van € 1.200. De startersaftrek bedraagt € 2.123.

programmes.name_en: Social Assistance for the Self-employed (municipal support or business loan)
programmes.amount_note: Temporary income support (gift or loan) up to bijstandsnorm for self-employed with a viable business, or a business loan (bedrijfskrediet) at low interest.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact your gemeente for a Bbz intake (via the bedrijfsadviseur)
Provide business and financial documents; gemeente assesses viability (levensvatbaarheid)

eligibility.income_note: Bbz werkkapitaal (a loan) has no income test. Bbz levensonderhoud tops up the entrepreneur's household income to the bijstandsnorm: single EUR 1,419.46/month = EUR 17,034/yr (Jul 2026, 12 x monthly incl. vakantietoeslag).

programmes.source_snippet: De gemeente ondersteunt zelfstandigen in financiële problemen met het Besluit bijstandverlening zelfstandigen (Bbz). Bijvoorbeeld door een renteloze lening.

programmes.name_local: SLIM-subsidie (Stimulering Leren en ontwikkelen in het mkb)
programmes.name_en: SLIM Subsidy (subsidy for learning & development in SMEs)
programmes.funder: RVO / Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid
programmes.amount_note: Subsidy for SMEs (and partnerships/large companies in agriculture, hospitality, recreation) for initiatives to stimulate employee learning & development; subsidy percentage depends on company size; opened in annual windows.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications in fixed annual windows (usually March and September); first-come-first-served while budget lasts.

procedure_steps.detail: Prepare your L&D initiative or plan
Apply via the RVO eLoket with eHerkenning during an application window

eligibility.income_note: For SMEs (max 250 employees); application is made by the employer

programmes.source_snippet: Met de SLIM-subsidie krijgen mkb-ondernemers een bijdrage voor initiatieven op het gebied van leren en ontwikkelen van werknemers.

programmes.name_en: ISDE Subsidy (heat pump, solar boiler, insulation, home battery for homeowners and landlords)
programmes.amount_note: At least EUR 500 for a (hybrid) heat pump; actual amount depends on type/meldcode. Subsidy for insulation doubles if you combine two measures within 24 months. From 2026 lower amounts for a 2nd or further air-water heat pump.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply after installation, within 24 months of completing the work (insulation and heat pump). From 2026 ventilation is also subsidised when combined with insulation.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the meldcodelijst for your heat pump/zonneboiler/isolatiemaatregel
Have the measure professionally installed; keep invoice, payment proof and photos
Apply online with DigiD within 24 months

eligibility.income_note: No income test; for owner-occupiers (and landlords/business users under separate ISDE rules) of a home in the Netherlands

programmes.source_snippet: U ontvangt altijd minimaal € 500 subsidie voor een (hybride)-warmtepomp. U vraagt de subsidie aan, binnen 24 maanden na installatie.

programmes.name_en: Energy Saving Loan (low-interest loan for home energy measures)
programmes.amount_note: Energy-saving loan for owner-occupiers via Nationaal Warmtefonds: EUR 1,000 to EUR 29,000 (up to EUR 8,500 for a home battery); 0% interest for owner-occupiers with taxable income under EUR 60,000. SVn stopped issuing these loans on 1 July 2021.

procedure_steps.detail: Get quotes for the energy-saving measures
Apply online at SVn with quotes and income details

eligibility.income_note: Homeowners (and via some municipalities also tenants with landlord consent); interest rate depends on income

programmes.source_snippet: Je kunt minimaal € 1.000 en maximaal € 29.000 lenen. Rente van 0% voor eigenaar-bewoners met verzamelinkomen van minder dan € 60.000.

programmes.name_en: Heat Fund (national loans for energy-saving home improvements)
programmes.amount_note: Loan EUR 1,000-29,000 (EUR 8,500 max for a home battery). 0% interest for owner-occupiers with verzamelinkomen under EUR 60,000. Age and income do not restrict who can borrow; you must own and live in the home.

procedure_steps.detail: Get quotes from certified installers
Apply online; Warmtefonds assesses creditworthiness

eligibility.income_note: For homeowners; loans subject to credit assessment

programmes.source_snippet: Je moet eigenaar en bewoner zijn van de te verduurzamen woning. Rente van 0% voor eigenaar-bewoners met verzamelinkomen van minder dan € 60.000. Je kunt minimaal € 1.000 en maximaal € 29.000 lenen.

programmes.name_en: SEVE Subsidy (energy-saving subsidy for homeowners' associations)
programmes.amount_note: Subsidy for Verenigingen van Eigenaren for energy advice (energieadvies) and energy-saving measures on the building envelope (roof, facade, glass) of apartment complexes; percentage of costs up to a maximum per dwelling.
programmes.deadline_note: Ended: the SEEH/SEVE subsidy for VvEs no longer accepts applications; replaced by the Subsidieregeling verduurzaming voor verenigingen van eigenaars (SVVE), open since 23 January 2023.

procedure_steps.detail: VvE appoints a contact person and checks eligibility
Apply via RVO eLoket with eHerkenning on behalf of the VvE

eligibility.income_note: For VvEs (homeowners' associations); not for individual owners

programmes.source_snippet: Let op: aanvragen voor de SEEH is niet meer mogelijk. Op 23 januari 2023 opende de Subsidie verduurzamen voor verenigingen van eigenaars (SVVE).

programmes.name_en: General Tax Credit (reduces income tax for all taxpayers, phased out with income)
programmes.amount_note: Maximum EUR 3,115 in 2026 (indicative, source: Belastingdienst tariffs); phased out by 6.398% of income above approx. EUR 29,736; zero above approx. EUR 78,426.
programmes.deadline_note: Applied automatically by employer/benefit payer via loonheffing, or in the income tax return.

procedure_steps.detail: Applied automatically via loonheffing or tax return; no application needed

eligibility.income_note: For everyone paying income tax in the Netherlands; amount decreases with income

programmes.source_snippet: De hoogte van de algemene heffingskorting is maximaal € 3.115.

programmes.name_en: Employment Tax Credit (tax credit for earned income)
programmes.amount_note: 2026: builds up to a maximum of EUR 5,685 at approx. EUR 45,592 of earned income, then phases out to zero at approx. EUR 132,920 (indicative tariffs).
programmes.deadline_note: Applied automatically via loonheffing or in the income tax return.

procedure_steps.detail: Applied automatically via employer/benefit payer or tax return

eligibility.income_note: Only over arbeidsinkomen (wages, profit, result from other work); builds up and phases out with income

programmes.source_snippet: U bereikt in 2026 nog niet de AOW-leeftijd: we nemen de arbeidskorting van uw werkgever over tot maximaal € 5.685. U hebt in 2026 het hele jaar de AOW-leeftijd: maximaal € 2.840.

programmes.name_en: Income-dependent Combination Tax Credit (working parents with a child under 12)
programmes.amount_note: 2026: up to EUR 3,032 (11.45% of earned income above EUR 6,239, capped); once per household, for the partner without a fiscal partner or the lower-earning partner; to be abolished in steps from 2027.
programmes.deadline_note: Applied via loonheffing if requested via the employer (model opgaaf gegevens voor de loonheffingen) or in the tax return.

procedure_steps.detail: Child under 12 registered at your address and earned income of at least EUR 6,239 (2026)
Apply via your employer's loonheffingsgegevens or claim in the tax return

eligibility.income_note: Arbeidsinkomen of at least approx. EUR 6,239 (2026); child younger than 12; only for single parents or the lowest-earning partner

programmes.source_snippet: Inkomensafhankelijke combinatiekorting: arbeidsinkomen vanaf € 6.239 tot € 32.710: 11,45% x (arbeidsinkomen - € 6.239).

programmes.name_en: Elderly Tax Credit (tax credit for people of AOW age)
programmes.amount_note: Ouderenkorting 2026 maximum EUR 2,067 (reduced by 15% of verzamelinkomen above about EUR 46,002). In addition the alleenstaandeouderenkorting is EUR 540 in 2026.

procedure_steps.detail: Applied automatically via loonheffing/tax return once you reach AOW age

eligibility.income_note: For people of AOW age; amount decreases with verzamelinkomen; extra credit for single elderly

programmes.source_snippet: Ouderenkorting: vanaf € 46.003 tot en met € 59.782: € 2.067 - 15% x (verzamelinkomen - € 46.002). Alleenstaandeouderenkorting 2026: € 540.

programmes.name_en: Young Disabled Persons' Tax Credit
programmes.amount_note: 2026: EUR 923 per year.

procedure_steps.detail: Usually applied automatically if you receive Wajong; otherwise claim in the tax return

documents_required.doc: Wajong-beschikking of bewijs van duurzame arbeidsongeschiktheid

eligibility.income_note: For people with Wajong or those unable to earn the minimum wage due to long-term illness/disability

programmes.source_snippet: In 2026 is de jonggehandicaptenkorting € 923.

programmes.name_en: Mortgage Interest Deduction (owner-occupied home)
programmes.amount_note: Mortgage interest on an owner-occupied home is deductible (annuity or linear 30-year mortgage). In 2026 the deduction is reduced for taxable income above EUR 78,426 (limited to the 37.56% rate); eigenwoningforfait adds taxable income.
programmes.deadline_note: Claim via voorlopige aanslag during the year or in the annual tax return.

procedure_steps.detail: Request a voorlopige aanslag for monthly refund or declare in the aangifte inkomstenbelasting

eligibility.income_note: For owner-occupiers with a mortgage on their main residence; deduction rate capped (2026: basic rate)

programmes.source_snippet: Is uw inkomen in 2026 hoger dan € 78.426? Dan krijgt u minder hypotheekrenteaftrek voor uw koopwoning.

programmes.name_en: First-time Buyers' Exemption from Transfer Tax
programmes.amount_note: 0% transfer tax (instead of 2% or the standard rate) for a home you will live in, with market value up to EUR 555,000 (2026). Usable once.
programmes.deadline_note: The notary applies the exemption at transfer; submit the Verklaring overdrachtsbelasting startersvrijstelling.

procedure_steps.detail: Sign the purchase contract as a first-time buyer aged 18-35
Give the completed startersvrijstelling declaration to the notary

eligibility.income_note: No income test. The Belastingdienst condition is a property-value cap: the woningwaarde may not exceed EUR 555,000 in 2026, the buyer must be 18-34 and must live in the home themselves.

programmes.source_snippet: U bent meerderjarig en jonger dan 35 jaar op het moment dat u de woning verkrijgt. Op het moment dat u de woning verkrijgt, mag de woningwaarde niet hoger zijn dan € 555.000.

programmes.name_en: National Mortgage Guarantee (lower interest rate and safety net for buyers)
programmes.amount_note: NHG limit 2026: mortgage up to EUR 470,000 (EUR 498,200 when including energy-saving measures).

procedure_steps.detail: Check the NHG cost limit (kostengrens) for the purchase year
Apply for NHG via your mortgage lender/adviser

eligibility.income_note: No income test beyond normal mortgage criteria; purchase price must be under the NHG kostengrens

programmes.source_snippet: De NHG-grens stijgt in 2026 van € 450.000 naar € 470.000. Met Energie Besparende Voorzieningen wordt de NHG-grens € 498.200.

programmes.name_en: Starter's Loan (municipal bridging loan for first-time buyers)
programmes.amount_note: Maximum 20% of purchase price or appraised value (and never above the municipality's cap); minimum EUR 2,500. Interest and repayment are paid by the municipality for the first 3 years; 30-year term; must be combined with an NHG mortgage.

procedure_steps.detail: Check whether your gemeente offers the Starterslening and its conditions
Apply at the gemeente with the signed (voorlopig) koopcontract; receive a toewijzingsbrief
Apply digitally for the loan at SVn with the toewijzingsbrief

eligibility.income_note: First-time buyer who will live in the home; only in municipalities offering the scheme; max purchase price varies per municipality

programmes.source_snippet: De SVn Starterslening wordt verstrekt voor het aankopen van de eerste woning. Er kan alleen een aanvraag bij SVn gedaan worden als er een toewijzingsbrief van de gemeente of provincie is. De SVn Starterslening is minimaal € 2.500,-.

programmes.name_en: Pregnancy and Childbirth Benefit (for self-employed and workers without employer wage payment)
programmes.amount_note: At least 100% of the statutory minimum wage (self-employed: based on worked hours, max minimum wage) during 16 weeks of zwangerschapsverlof; employees receive the WAZO uitkering via employer/UWV at 100% of wage.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply between 4 and 2 weeks before the date you want the benefit to start (up to 1 year retroactively). Benefit lasts at least 16 weeks.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via uwv.nl with DigiD (zwangerschapsuitkering aanvragen)
Provide zwangerschapsverklaring (due date statement) from midwife

eligibility.income_note: For pregnant (former) workers; self-employed need to have worked sufficient hours; employees usually via employer

programmes.source_snippet: De zwangerschaps- en bevallingsuitkering voor zelfstandigen (ZEZ-uitkering) duurt minstens 16 weken. Aanvragen kan tussen de 4 en 2 weken voor de datum dat u de uitkering wilt starten.

programmes.name_en: Paid Parental Leave (9 weeks at 70% of wage in the child's first year)
programmes.amount_note: 9 weeks of paid parental leave at 70% of the daily wage (dagloon; capped at 70% of the maximum dagloon), taken within the child's first year (adoption/foster: within 1 year of placement and before the child is 8). Employees only. The partner's aanvullend geboorteverlof is a separate UWV scheme that also pays 70% of dagloon.
programmes.deadline_note: Discuss the leave with your employer at least 2 months before the first leave day; take it within 1 year of the birth. The employer applies for the uitkering at UWV (decision within 4 weeks).

procedure_steps.detail: Notify your employer at least 2 months before taking the leave
Employer applies for the betaald ouderschapsverlof uitkering at UWV

eligibility.income_note: Employment-based (employees incl. on-call/agency workers, alfahulp, dga); the self-employed are not listed as eligible. Only in the first year after birth; the remaining 17 weeks of the 26-week parental leave are unpaid. Each parent has full entitlement.

programmes.source_snippet: Ouderschapsverlof bestaat uit 17 weken onbetaald verlof en 9 weken betaald verlof.

programmes.name_en: Adoption or Foster Care Benefit (6 weeks of paid leave)
programmes.amount_note: 100% of the daily wage (dagloon) for employees, for up to 6 weeks of adoptie- or pleegzorgverlof; one benefit claim per adoption/placement, also for several children at once. Parents on WW, Ziektewet or loongerelateerde WGA get a benefit equal to their existing benefit.
programmes.deadline_note: The employer or the parent can apply between 4 and 2 weeks before the leave starts.

procedure_steps.detail: Request the leave from your employer; employer applies at UWV (self-employed apply directly)
Provide adoption/foster placement documents

eligibility.income_note: For employees and self-employed adopting or fostering a child

programmes.source_snippet: Voor ouders met een werkgever is de uitkering 100% van het dagloon. [...] Het verlof duurt maximaal 6 weken.

programmes.name_en: Long-term Care Act (24-hour care for people needing permanent supervision or care)
programmes.amount_note: Care in kind (residential care, care at home with 24h supervision) under the Wlz; statutory eigen bijdrage (own contribution) applies, income- and age-dependent (low/high tariff).

procedure_steps.detail: Request a Wlz-indicatie at the CIZ (Centrum Indicatiestelling Zorg)
Choose a zorgaanbieder; the zorgkantoor (health insurer) contracts the care
Pay the wettelijke eigen bijdrage (income-dependent)

eligibility.income_note: No income ceiling for the indication; the CAK charges an income- and asset-dependent eigen bijdrage (laag/hoog) for Wlz care.

programmes.source_snippet: Heeft u, of uw kind, 24 uur per dag zorg of toezicht nodig? Via de Wet langdurige zorg krijgt u alle zorg die u nodig heeft voor uw aandoening of beperking.

programmes.name_en: Personal Budget (buy your own care/support under Wlz, Wmo, Jeugdwet or Zvw)
programmes.amount_note: Budget instead of care in kind, to hire your own care providers; amount based on the indicated care need; administration via SVB.
programmes.deadline_note: Application route depends on the law: Wlz via CIZ indication then zorgkantoor; Wmo and Jeugdwet via the gemeente; Zvw via the zorgverzekeraar.

procedure_steps.detail: Get an indicatie (Wlz via CIZ, Wmo via gemeente, Jeugdwet via gemeente, Zvw via zorgverzekeraar)
Apply for the pgb at the granting authority; SVB administers payments

eligibility.income_note: For people with a care indication under Wlz, Wmo (gemeente), Jeugdwet or Zvw (health insurance)

programmes.source_snippet: Hoe u een PGB aanvraagt, hangt af van de wet waaruit u een PGB wilt ontvangen.

programmes.name_en: Allowance for the Chronically Ill and Disabled (annual municipal allowance)
programmes.amount_note: There is no single national allowance: some municipalities pay a 'meerkostenregeling' to people who are permanently ill or have a disability. Amount and conditions differ per municipality; ask your gemeente.
programmes.deadline_note: Set by each municipality; check with your gemeente.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the scheme on your gemeente website (zoek 'tegemoetkoming chronisch zieken')
Apply at the gemeente with DigiD, with medical and income details

documents_required.doc: Bewijs van chronische ziekte of handicap (artsenverklaring kan gevraagd worden)

eligibility.income_note: Income thresholds are set per municipality and are not published nationally; the previous single national figure (EUR 22,144) is not supported by an official source.

programmes.source_snippet: Verschillende gemeenten betalen een bedrag uit aan blijvend zieke mensen en mensen met een beperking. Dit zijn de zogenaamde meerkostenregelingen. De hoogte van het bedrag en de voorwaarden kunnen per gemeente verschillen.

programmes.name_local: Hulpmiddelen via de Wmo (rolstoel, scootmobiel, woningaanpassing)
programmes.name_en: Aids and Home Adaptations via the Social Support Act (wheelchair, mobility scooter)
programmes.amount_note: Loan or provision of aids (wheelchair, mobility scooter, home adaptations) based on a Wmo assessment; an eigen bijdrage (often capped, e.g. EUR 19 per 4 weeks per aid) may apply.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply at your gemeente; the gemeente investigates (usually a conversation) what you need. A wheelchair via the Wmo is only provided if needed for a longer period; temporary aids via the thuiszorgwinkel or your health insurer.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at the Wmo-loket of your gemeente
Gemeente assesses via keukentafelgesprek/ergotherapeut; aid is provided in loan or pgb

eligibility.income_note: No income ceiling; the inkomensafhankelijke eigen bijdrage (CAK) rises with income but never exceeds the cost of the provision.

programmes.source_snippet: Bent u onvoldoende zelfredzaam of kunt u niet goed meedoen in de maatschappij? En kan uw netwerk ook niet bijdragen? Dan is de gemeente verplicht ondersteuning te bieden.

programmes.name_en: Disabled Parking Card (EU-wide parking permit)
programmes.amount_note: Allows parking in general disabled bays (EU-wide card, valid at most 5 years). Municipalities set their own fees (leges) for the application and the medical examination; there is no national maximum.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply at the gemeente where you are registered (or at CBR if not registered in a municipality); renew with the gemeente before expiry (max. 5 years).

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at your gemeente (often online with DigiD)
Medical assessment (gemeentelijke keuring) unless automatically exempt (e.g. blind, WIA 100%)

eligibility.income_note: Driver card (B): cannot walk more than 100 metres independently with aids for at least half a year and holds a driving licence. Passenger card (P): same walking limit and needs continuous help of the driver for door-to-door transport. Assessed by a medical examiner. No income test.

programmes.source_snippet: U kunt een gehandicaptenparkeerkaart aanvragen bij de gemeente waar u staat ingeschreven. Een keuringsarts bepaalt na medisch onderzoek of u voldoet aan de voorwaarden.

programmes.name_en: Waiver of Municipal Taxes (OZB, waste and sewage levies for low incomes)
programmes.amount_note: Full or partial waiver of gemeentelijke belastingen (afvalstoffenheffing, rioolheffing, OZB) for households at or below (often) 100-130% of the bijstandsnorm; in many municipalities granted automatically to benefit recipients.
programmes.deadline_note: Den Haag: apply if the assessment is unpaid or was paid less than 3 months ago; you hear within 13 weeks. Other municipalities have their own rules and forms.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the kwijtscheldingsbeleid of your gemeente
Apply online with DigiD at the gemeente or its belastingsamenwerking (e.g. BsGW, BGH)

eligibility.income_note: Statutory kwijtscheldingsnorm is 90% of the bijstandsnorm (art. 16 Uitvoeringsregeling Invorderingswet 1990); most municipalities apply 100%. 100% norm single = EUR 1,401.50/month (Jan 2026) = EUR 16,818/yr (conversion: 12 x monthly); couples EUR 2,002.13/month = EUR 24,026/yr. Separate asset, vehicle and home-equity tests; kwijtschelding percentage varies by municipality (e.g. up to 76.5-100% of afvalstoffenheffing).

programmes.source_snippet: Heeft u een laag inkomen? En kunt u uw rekeningen moeilijk betalen? Dan kunt u soms kwijtschelding van gemeentelijke belasting krijgen.

programmes.name_en: Amsterdam City Pass (free and discounted sports, culture and activities for low incomes)
programmes.amount_note: Free or heavily discounted access to swimming pools, museums, sports clubs and courses; holders with a low income get a green dot (groene stip) for the biggest discounts, plus schemes like free swimming lessons for children and the laptop scheme for school pupils.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply online (DigiD) or on paper; response within 8 weeks, pass sent within 3 weeks. The pass is free.

procedure_steps.detail: Check your income against the Stadspas threshold
Apply online with DigiD at amsterdam.nl/stadspas
Receive the pass at home and use it at participating venues

eligibility.income_note: Amsterdam or Weesp residents aged 18+ with a low income and little assets (amounts on amsterdam.nl 'wat is een laag inkomen'). Students cannot apply if their study qualifies for studiefinanciering or WTOS, even if they do not receive it. The EUR 22,144/yr (130% bijstandsnorm) figure is not stated on the Stadspas page and is unverified.

programmes.source_snippet: Vraag de Stadspas aan als je een laag inkomen en weinig vermogen hebt en woont in Amsterdam of Weesp. De Stadspas is gratis.

programmes.name_en: Rotterdam City Pass (free and discounted leisure activities for low incomes)
programmes.amount_note: Standard rate EUR 65 per person for everyone. Low rate (net monthly household income excl. toeslagen up to EUR 1,775 single / 2,000 single parent / 2,525 couple): EUR 5 per adult, EUR 0 per child up to 17. Middle rate EUR 32.50 per adult / EUR 10 per child. Child rate EUR 20; student rate EUR 20 (full-time MBO/HBO/WO up to 33). Pass year 1 March 2026 - 28 February 2027.
programmes.deadline_note: Pass year runs 1 March 2026 to 28 February 2027; order or renew online with DigiD or at a verkooppunt.

procedure_steps.detail: Check income conditions on rotterdam.nl
Apply with DigiD via the gemeente

eligibility.income_note: Low rate (EUR 5) net household income excl. toeslagen: EUR 1,775/month single = EUR 21,300/yr (x12); single parent EUR 2,000/month = EUR 24,000/yr; couple EUR 2,525/month = EUR 30,300/yr. Middle rate up to EUR 2,050 / 2,350 / 2,900 per month. Figure shown is the single-person low-rate limit. Note: 'free' in the old description is wrong for adults; the low rate is EUR 5.

programmes.source_snippet: Je komt in aanmerking voor het laag tarief als het gezamenlijke netto-maandinkomen (excl. toeslagen) niet hoger is dan: EUR 1.775,- alleenstaanden; EUR 2.000,- alleenstaande ouders; EUR 2.525,- gehuwd/samenwonend.

programmes.name_en: The Hague City Pass (free and discounted activities for low incomes)
programmes.amount_note: Free or discounted sports, culture, library and leisure activities for residents of Den Haag with a low income; includes schemes such as the laptop scheme for pupils.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the income threshold on denhaag.nl
Apply online with DigiD

eligibility.income_note: For Den Haag residents with a low income linked to the bijstandsnorm (single norm EUR 1,419.46/month incl. vakantietoeslag = EUR 17,034/yr, Jul 2026); the municipal threshold may be slightly higher. AOW-age holders also get free HTM travel.

programmes.source_snippet: Met de Ooievaarspas krijgen Hagenaars met een laag inkomen korting of gratis toegang tot activiteiten in Den Haag.

programmes.name_en: Utrecht City Pass (free and discounted sports, culture and activities for low incomes)
programmes.amount_note: Free or discounted access to sports clubs, swimming, museums and courses for Utrecht residents with a low income; separate U-pas for children.
programmes.deadline_note: Pass year 2026-2027 runs 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027. People with a municipal benefit receive the U-pas automatically; others apply or renew with DigiD (income shared via the Ockto app).

procedure_steps.detail: Check the income conditions on utrecht.nl
Apply with DigiD via the gemeente

eligibility.income_note: Gross income must not exceed the income limit of your municipality (published as an image table on u-pas.nl, not extractable); people with a municipal benefit get it automatically. Exceptions possible for debt restructuring (WSNP), a recent income drop or persistently high costs. The EUR 17,034/yr figure in the previous record is unverified.

programmes.source_snippet: Heb je een uitkering van de gemeente? Dan krijg je de U-pas automatisch. [...] Dan mag je bruto inkomen niet hoger zijn dan de inkomensgrens van jouw gemeente.

programmes.name_en: Youth Sports Fund (pays sports club fees and gear for children from low-income families)
programmes.amount_note: Pays the membership fee (contributie) and often equipment (e.g. sports clothing) for children and young people aged 0 to 18 from families with too little money, usually most or all of the fee up to a maximum that differs per municipality. Paid directly to the club; no repayment; a new application each sport year. Application goes via an intermediary (teacher, youth worker, helper) or the kieseenclub.nl check.

procedure_steps.detail: Ask an intermediair (school, CJG, gemeente, sports coach) to apply
The fund assesses and pays the club directly

eligibility.income_note: No national income cap: 'Hoe hoog mag mijn inkomen zijn? Dit verschilt per gemeente.' No proof of income is required; the local fund decides. The earlier EUR 20,440 figure is not supported.

programmes.source_snippet: Het Jeugdfonds helpt kinderen en jongeren van 0 tot 18 jaar uit gezinnen waar te weinig geld is voor sport of cultuur.

programmes.name_en: Youth Culture Fund (pays music, dance and art lessons for children from low-income families)
programmes.amount_note: Pays lesson fees (music, dance, theatre, painting, singing, ballet) and often equipment such as an instrument for children and young people aged 0 to 18 from families with too little money, usually most or all of the fee up to a maximum that differs per municipality. Paid directly to the provider; no repayment; a new application each year. Application via an intermediary or the kieseenclub.nl check.

procedure_steps.detail: Ask an intermediair (school, CJG, gemeente) to apply at the fund
The fund pays the cultural institution directly

eligibility.income_note: No national income cap: 'Hoe hoog mag mijn inkomen zijn? Dit verschilt per gemeente.' No proof of income is required; the local fund decides. The earlier EUR 20,440 figure is not supported.

programmes.source_snippet: Cultuuractiviteiten bijvoorbeeld muziekles, dansen, toneel, schilderen, zangles of ballet.

programmes.name_en: Leergeld Foundation (laptop, school costs, bicycle and activities for children in poverty)
programmes.amount_note: Help for children aged 0 to 18 from families with money worries: e.g. a bicycle, a laptop/school costs and club fees; what can be claimed and the maximum differ per local Leergeld foundation. 16-17 year olds in MBO can use the mbo-studentenfonds. Only available where a local foundation is active (otherwise see Sam& voor alle kinderen).

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the local Leergeld foundation or via school/gemeente
Intake at home; foundation provides the needed items or pays the provider

eligibility.income_note: Household income must not be too high relative to the social minimum (page: EUR 1,348.49/month net single parent with children, EUR 1,926.40/month family with children, as of 1 July); each local foundation applies its own percentage, up to 150%. No single national euro cap, so the earlier EUR 20,440 figure is not supported.

programmes.source_snippet: Leergeld is er voor kinderen in de leeftijd van 0 tot 18 jaar uit gezinnen met geldzorgen. De kinderen kunnen door geldgebrek niet meedoen met hun leeftijdsgenootjes.

programmes.name_en: Subsidised Legal Aid (state-funded lawyer with income-dependent own contribution)
programmes.amount_note: The state pays most of the lawyer's costs; you pay an income-dependent eigen bijdrage (regular advocatuur toevoeging 2026: EUR 257 to EUR 1,084; family-law toevoeging EUR 448 to EUR 1,120; LAT EUR 101 or EUR 170). Free advice is available at het Juridisch Loket.

procedure_steps.detail: Get free advice first at het Juridisch Loket
Choose a lawyer; the lawyer applies for the toevoeging at the Raad voor Rechtsbijstand
Pay the eigen bijdrage based on your income

documents_required.doc: Inkomens- en vermogensgegevens (toets via Belastingdienst, peiljaar 2 jaar terug)

eligibility.income_note: 2026 thresholds (peiljaar 2024) for a regular toevoeging: fiscal annual income up to EUR 35,400 (single) / EUR 50,000 (couple or single parent); the own contribution rises with income (single: EUR 257 up to EUR 25,200, EUR 475, 678, 882, 1,084 up to EUR 35,400). Assets above EUR 36,952 per person (box 3, 2024) exclude you. The figure in income_annual_max is the single-person limit.

programmes.source_snippet: Vanaf 1 januari 2026 gelden nieuwe inkomens- en vermogensnormen voor de gesubsidieerde rechtsbijstand en mediation.

programmes.name_en: Food Bank (weekly food parcels for households below the threshold)
programmes.amount_note: Free weekly food parcels (about 25 products, roughly 3 days of meals). You may collect for at least 4 weeks after sign-up; in principle help lasts 3 years.

procedure_steps.detail: Register at your local voedselbank (via voedselbankennederland.nl)
Intake on income and household; if eligible, weekly parcel collection

eligibility.income_note: No fixed income ceiling: you qualify if after paying fixed costs you have too little left for food. Example amounts left per month: single EUR 335; couple or single parent with 1 child EUR 460; family with 2 children EUR 710. Savings count only above EUR 5,220 (single) / 6,850 (couple) / 7,550 (family with 2 children).

programmes.source_snippet: Je kunt voedselhulp krijgen als je na het betalen van je vaste lasten te weinig geld overhoudt voor eten en andere belangrijke dingen.

programmes.name_en: NS Off-Peak Discount Subscription (40% discount outside rush hours)
programmes.amount_note: NS Flex Dal Voordeel: 40% discount on train travel in off-peak hours (Mon-Fri 9:00-16:00 and 18:30-6:30), all weekend and on public holidays; subscription EUR 6.35 per month (promotional price EUR 3.50/month shown on the page; the page's FAQ still says EUR 6.35). Dal Voordeel op saldo: EUR 76.20 per year paid up front. Discount applies only on trains (not bus/tram/metro).

procedure_steps.detail: Order the subscription online at ns.nl (linked to your personal OV-chipkaart)
Check in/out with your OV-chipkaart; discount applies automatically in off-peak hours

eligibility.income_note: No income test; paid commercial subscription; 60+ and student variants exist

programmes.source_snippet: Je reist met 40% korting in de daluren, het weekend en op feestdagen.

programmes.name_en: NS Combined Travel Discount (40% off-peak discount when travelling with a subscription holder)
programmes.amount_note: Subscription holders can give up to 3 fellow travellers 40% discount in off-peak hours and weekends/holidays; the fellow traveller receives a samenreiscode and arranges the discount on ns.nl or in the app.

procedure_steps.detail: Buy/load Samenreiskorting via the NS app, ns.nl or a ticket machine onto your OV-chipkaart
Travel in the same train as the subscription holder during off-peak hours

eligibility.income_note: No income test; must travel with an NS subscription holder, off-peak

programmes.source_snippet: Stap in met Samenreiskorting en krijg 40% korting op je treinrit. [...] Geef maximaal 3 medereizigers 40% korting in daluren + weekend.

programmes.name_en: Company Bike Scheme (tax-advantaged bicycle via employer)
programmes.funder: Werkgevers / leasemaatschappijen (o.a. Lease a Bike, Hellorider)
programmes.amount_note: Bike you may also use privately: your employer adds 7% of the list price to your salary per year (bijtelling); business-only use is untaxed. Alternatively an interest-free employer loan (tax-free) with a tax-free allowance of up to EUR 0.25 per business km in 2026. With a bike plan the employer may not also pay a km allowance.

procedure_steps.detail: Ask your employer whether it offers a fietsplan or bike lease scheme
Choose a bike within the scheme's budget; employer settles via payroll

eligibility.income_note: Only if your employer offers the scheme; 7% bijtelling applies for private use of a company bike

programmes.source_snippet: Krijgt u van uw werkgever een fiets die u ook privé mag gebruiken? Dan telt uw werkgever 7% van de adviesprijs op bij uw loon. Dit heet de bijtelling.

programmes.name_en: Collective Health Insurance (group discount on health insurance premium)
programmes.amount_note: Group contracts via employers, unions or associations typically give a premium discount (a few percent) on the basic and supplementary health insurance; compare with individual policies before choosing.
programmes.deadline_note: Ended: since 2023 no discount is allowed on a collective BASIC health insurance. Collective discounts on supplementary insurance (aanvullende verzekering) and care-related agreements remain possible.

procedure_steps.detail: Check whether your employer, union or association has a collectiviteit
Take out the collective policy before 31 December for the new year

eligibility.income_note: Gemeentepolis/collective health insurance is for incomes up to about 120-130% of the bijstandsnorm (e.g. gemeente Maasdriel: 130% excl. vakantiegeld). 130% incl. vakantiegeld = EUR 1,845.30/month single = EUR 22,144/yr (2026).

programmes.source_snippet: U kunt sinds 2023 geen korting meer krijgen op een collectieve basiszorgverzekering. Zorgverzekeraars kunnen nog wel zorginhoudelijke afspraken maken voor collectief verzekerden. Ook kortingen op aanvullende verzekeringen blijven mogelijk.

programmes.name_en: Maternity Care (postnatal care at home, covered by basic health insurance)
programmes.amount_note: Kraamzorg is paid from the basic health insurance: 24 to 80 hours depending on the situation, usually up to day 8 (sometimes 10) after birth. Own contribution at home in 2026: EUR 5.70 per hour; no contribution in hospital and none for assistance during the birth (partusassistentie). Not part of the mandatory eigen risico.
programmes.deadline_note: Register with a kraamzorg organisation (often possible from week 12 of pregnancy); intake about 2 months before the due date; check your insurer's policy for contracted organisations.

procedure_steps.detail: Register with a kraamzorgbureau (often covered via your zorgverzekeraar)
Declare via your health insurer; eigen bijdrage per hour applies unless covered by aanvullende verzekering

eligibility.income_note: Basic-package entitlement for everyone who lives or works in the Netherlands and holds basic health insurance; no income test. Own contribution EUR 5.70 per hour at home (2026).

programmes.source_snippet: Voor kraamzorg thuis betaalt u in 2026 een eigen bijdrage van € 5,70 per uur. Voor de kraamzorg in ziekenhuis betaalt u geen eigen bijdrage.

programmes.name_en: Valys - subsidised inter-regional taxi transport for people with a mobility impairment
programmes.funder: Ministerie van Volksgezondheid, Welzijn en Sport (uitvoering: Valys/Transvision)
programmes.amount_note: Subsidised taxi fare of EUR 0.288/km within the persoonlijk kilometerbudget (PKB, standard 700 km/year in 2026; EUR 1.777/km above the budget). One companion always travels free. A high PKB (2,350 km) exists for severe mobility impairment.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply for a free Valyspas with proof of mobility impairment (Wmo transport decision, disabled parking card, OV-begeleiderskaart or wheelchair/scootmobiel statement)
Book door-to-door trips (25 km or more) by phone or online and pay the reduced fare

documents_required.doc: Proof of impairment: Wmo-beschikking vervoer, gehandicaptenparkeerkaart, OV-begeleiderskaart or hulpmiddel statement

eligibility.income_note: No income test; eligibility is based on a mobility impairment, not income.

programmes.source_snippet: Voor Valys betaalt u een gereduceerd taxitarief ... U betaalt zelf een reizigersbijdrage, de Rijksoverheid betaalt de rest.

programmes.name_local: LBIO: gratis inning en voorschot kinderalimentatie
programmes.name_en: LBIO - free collection of and advance on child maintenance
programmes.amount_note: LBIO collects court-ordered or agreed child maintenance free of charge for the receiving parent; if the paying parent defaults, LBIO can pay an advance (voorschot) equal to the maintenance amount. Alimentatie indexation 2026: 4.6%.

procedure_steps.detail: Check conditions: maintenance fixed by court or covenant, and at least one missed payment in the last 6 months
Submit the collection/advance request to LBIO with the court order or covenant

documents_required.doc: Court order or echtscheidingsconvenant/ouderschapsplan with the alimentatie amount

eligibility.income_note: No income test for the receiving parent; conditions concern the maintenance obligation and default by the paying parent.

programmes.source_snippet: De dienstverlening door het LBIO is kosteloos voor de alimentatiegerechtigde. Het LBIO probeert dan altijd eerst om de rechtstreekse betalingen op gang te brengen.

programmes.name_en: Free public transport pass for minimum-income residents (Zuid-Holland pilot)
programmes.amount_note: Free travel in off-peak hours (weekdays after 9:00; all day at weekends and on public holidays) on Qbuzz buses in Zuid-Holland Noord and DMG, Transdev buses in Hoeksche Waard/Goeree-Overflakkee, the TAG line (NS) Alphen-Gouda, some Syntus lines, the Merwedelingelijn train and the Waterbus. Provincial pilot 2026-2029, EUR 2.5 million per year; 29 municipalities may take part and each decides whether to join; the Rotterdam-Den Haag metropolitan region is not included.
programmes.deadline_note: Pilot 2026-2029; participating municipalities register eligible residents (via WijMobiel); check whether your gemeente takes part.

procedure_steps.detail: Check whether your gemeente participates in the pilot (29 gemeenten can join)
Apply with proof of low income; the free travel product is loaded onto your personal OV-chipkaart

eligibility.income_note: For residents with a minimum income, around 100-120% of the bijstandsnorm (120% = EUR 1,703.35/month single incl. vakantiegeld = EUR 20,440/yr, Jul 2026; conversion 12 x monthly). Exact threshold set per participating gemeente.

programmes.source_snippet: Vanaf januari 2026 kunnen inwoners met een laag inkomen gratis reizen met het openbaar vervoer in de regio Zuid-Holland Noord.

programmes.name_local: Gratis reizen met HTM voor AOW'ers met Ooievaarspas (Den Haag)
programmes.name_en: Free HTM bus/tram travel for AOW-age Ooievaarspas holders in The Hague
programmes.amount_note: Free travel on HTM bus, tram and RandstadRail for Den Haag residents who receive AOW and hold an Ooievaarspas. Free travel is loaded onto an OV-pas (EUR 6, from Primera or the HTM service shop) with a voucher code from the gemeente's letter; the OV-chipkaart is being replaced by OVpay in 2027.
programmes.deadline_note: The gemeente checks Ooievaarspas eligibility every year and sends a new letter; if none arrives by December, contact the gemeente.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply for the Ooievaarspas at gemeente Den Haag (low-income test)
Return the 'Registratie ov-chipkaartnummer' form from the gemeente letter
Collect the product onto your personal OV-chipkaart at an oplaadpaal or automaat

documents_required.doc: Gemeente letter 'Gratis reizen' with registration form

eligibility.income_note: Requires the Ooievaarspas, i.e. a low income around the bijstandsnorm per the Den Haag municipal threshold (single norm EUR 1,419.46/month incl. vakantietoeslag = EUR 17,034/yr, Jul 2026).

programmes.source_snippet: Krijgt u AOW? En heeft u recht op een Ooievaarspas? Dan kunt u gratis reizen met de bus, tram of RandstadRail.

programmes.name_local: Gratis OV-abonnement minima Amersfoort (incl. NS Vooruitpas-proef)
programmes.name_en: Free public transport for low-income Amersfoort residents
programmes.funder: Gemeente Amersfoort (met NS voor de Vooruitpas-proef)
programmes.amount_note: Free bus, tram, buurtbus and flex services of U-OV in the whole province of Utrecht for one year, off-peak: Mon-Fri before 6:30, 9:00-16:00 and after 18:30, all weekend and public holidays. Applications for 2026 closed on 30 September 2026. Separate NS 'Gratis reizen met de trein' trial: invitation-only (letter), not open to apply.
programmes.deadline_note: Closed: applications for the 2026 free OV subscription were possible until 30 September 2026 and are no longer possible. The gemeente will say in spring 2027 whether the scheme is extended for 2027.

procedure_steps.detail: Check eligibility (lower income, AOW or pension) on the gemeente page
Apply online; the free product is linked to your personal OV-chipkaart

documents_required.doc: Proof of low income or AOW/pension

eligibility.income_note: Net monthly household income up to 150% of the bijstandsnorm excl. vakantiegeld: single (parent) EUR 1,997.13 (21 to AOW age) or EUR 2,229.69 (AOW age); couple EUR 2,853.03 / EUR 3,055.43. Annualised single 21-to-AOW figure = 12 x 1,997.13 = EUR 23,966 (couple EUR 34,236). Also requires residence in Amersfoort, DigiD and a personal OV-chipkaart with photo.

programmes.source_snippet: Inwoners met en lager inkomen, AOW of pensioen konden tot en met 30 september 2026 een gratis OV-abonnement aanvragen.

programmes.name_en: Small-scale Investment Deduction (KIA)
programmes.amount_note: Extra profit deduction for entrepreneurs investing in business assets: 2026 table - 28% of total investments between EUR 2,901 and EUR 71,683; fixed EUR 20,072 between EUR 71,684 and EUR 132,746; then EUR 20,072 minus 7.56% of the excess above EUR 132,746 up to EUR 398,236; nil above. Minimum EUR 450 per asset.
programmes.deadline_note: Claimed in the income or corporation tax return for the year of investment

procedure_steps.detail: Invest in qualifying business assets (min EUR 450 each; total above EUR 2,901 in 2026)
Claim the KIA in your aangifte inkomsten- of vennootschapsbelasting

documents_required.doc: Invoices/proof of investment and commissioning date

eligibility.income_note: No income test; investment-volume based. Applies to income-tax and corporation-tax entrepreneurs.

programmes.source_snippet: Om in 2026 in aanmerking te komen voor de kleinschaligheidsinvesteringsaftrek (KIA) moet u een bedrag tussen € 2.901 en € 398.236 investeren in bedrijfsmiddelen voor uw onderneming.

programmes.name_en: SME Profit Exemption
programmes.amount_note: Automatic exemption of 12.7% of profit in 2026, after deducting the ondernemersaftrek. In 2026 the deduction value is limited: the benefit is calculated at a rate of 37.56%.
programmes.deadline_note: Applied automatically in the income tax return

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

eligibility.income_note: No income test; applies to every entrepreneur for income tax regardless of profit level.

programmes.source_snippet: In 2026 is de mkb-winstvrijstelling 12,7% van de winst, nadat u deze hebt verminderd met de ondernemersaftrek.

programmes.name_en: Innovation Box (9% corporation tax on innovation profits)
programmes.amount_note: Profits from self-developed innovative activities (with a patent, plant breeder's right or WBSO R&D statement) are taxed in the innovatiebox at 9% vennootschapsbelasting instead of the regular 19%/25.8% (2026). Requires a ruling-style allocation of innovation profits.
programmes.deadline_note: Elected in the corporation tax return; often combined with a vooroverleg/ruling

procedure_steps.detail: Ensure the innovation qualifies (patent, kwekersrecht or WBSO-verklaring for own R&D)
Allocate innovation profits and apply the 9% box in the Vpb return

documents_required.doc: WBSO-verklaring, patent or other entry ticket (toegangsticket)

eligibility.income_note: No income test; applies to corporate taxpayers with qualifying innovation profits.

programmes.source_snippet: Alle winsten die u behaalt met innovatieve activiteiten waarvoor RVO een S&O-verklaring heeft afgegeven, vallen in deze box. Het effectieve tarief van de vennootschapsbelasting voor deze winsten is 9%.

programmes.name_en: Co-working Spouse Deduction
programmes.amount_note: Deduction as a percentage of profit, based on hours the fiscal partner works unpaid: 525-875 hours = 1.25%; 875-1,225 = 2%; 1,225-1,750 = 3%; 1,750 or more = 4%. Fewer than 525 hours gives no deduction. EUR 5,000 is NOT the deduction: it is the limit for any pay to the partner (below EUR 5,000 the pay is not deductible and not income for the partner).
programmes.deadline_note: Claimed in the income tax return

procedure_steps.detail: Keep records of the partner's unpaid working hours (min 525/year)
Claim meewerkaftrek in the aangifte inkomstenbelasting

documents_required.doc: Hour records of the co-working partner

eligibility.income_note: No income test; you must be an entrepreneur who meets the urencriterium, and your fiscal partner must work at least 525 hours in the business unpaid or for pay below EUR 5,000. No deduction on profit as a medegerechtigde.

programmes.source_snippet: Uw fiscale partner werkt 525 uur of meer in uw onderneming. [...] 525 - 875: 1,25% van de winst; 875 - 1.225: 2% van de winst; 1.225 - 1.750: 3% van de winst; 1.750 of meer: 4% van de winst.

programmes.name_en: Annuity Premium Deduction
programmes.amount_note: Premiums/contributions for a qualifying lijfrente (annuity) are deductible from income in box 1 within the annual jaarruimte (30% of the premiegrondslag above the AOW-franchise) plus unused reserveringsruimte of the previous 10 years.
programmes.deadline_note: Claimed in the income tax return; the jaarruimte for 2025 is based on 2024 income and pension data (UPO). Unused jaarruimte of earlier years can be used as reserveringsruimte.

procedure_steps.detail: Calculate your jaarruimte (Belastingdienst rekentool or via your pension administrator's UPO factor A)
Take out a qualifying lijfrente and deduct the premiums in your aangifte

documents_required.doc: UPO / factor A of any pension scheme

eligibility.income_note: No income ceiling; deduction limited by the personal jaarruimte, which grows with income.

programmes.source_snippet: Alleen als u in een jaar een pensioentekort hebt, mag u uw uitgaven voor een lijfrenteverzekering, lijfrenterekening of lijfrentebeleggingsrecht aftrekken. Dat mag tot het bedrag van uw jaarruimte.

programmes.name_en: Deduction of Specific Healthcare Costs
programmes.amount_note: Qualifying healthcare costs above an income-dependent threshold are deductible. 2025 threshold (drempelinkomen EUR 9,535 to 50,635): 1.65% of drempelinkomen; at EUR 0-9,534: EUR 164; above EUR 50,635: EUR 835 + 5.75% of the part above EUR 50,635. With a fiscal partner the whole year, incomes are added: up to EUR 19,068: EUR 328.
programmes.deadline_note: Claimed in the income tax return of the year the costs were paid

procedure_steps.detail: Check whether your costs qualify (list on belastingdienst.nl) and keep receipts
Enter the costs above the drempel in your aangifte inkomstenbelasting

eligibility.income_note: No income ceiling; the deductible excess shrinks as drempelinkomen rises (income-dependent drempel).

programmes.source_snippet: Hebt u in 2025 veel zorgkosten gemaakt? Dan mag u alleen het deel van de uitgaven onder voorwaarden aftrekken dat uitkomt boven een bepaalde drempel.

programmes.name_en: Charitable Donations Deduction
programmes.amount_note: Regular gifts: deductible above a threshold of 1% of drempelinkomen (minimum EUR 60), capped at 10% of drempelinkomen. Periodic gifts: fully deductible with no threshold, up to EUR 1,500,000 per year in 2026. Gifts to cultural ANBIs get an extra 25% uplift (max EUR 1,250 uplift).
programmes.deadline_note: Claimed in the income tax return

procedure_steps.detail: Check the charity's ANBI status in the Belastingdienst ANBI register
For full deduction, record a periodieke gift in an agreement for at least 5 years

eligibility.income_note: No income ceiling; deductible share scales with drempelinkomen (drempel 1%, cap 10%).

programmes.source_snippet: Het drempelbedrag voor gewone giften is 1% van uw drempelinkomen met een minimum van € 60. Wat u meer hebt betaald dan dit drempelbedrag, mag u aftrekken.

programmes.name_en: Municipal Debt Assistance
programmes.amount_note: Free, statutory debt counselling via your gemeente: budget coaching, debt restructuring (minnelijke sanering) and, as last resort, the Wsnp legal debt restructuring. Under the 'vroeg erbij' approach, gemeenten must proactively contact residents after signals such as missed zorgpremie payments.
programmes.deadline_note: After you report to your gemeente you hear within 4 weeks what help to expect and the gemeente decides within 8 weeks; in a threatening situation (eviction, utilities cut off) the gemeente must help within 3 days.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the schuldhulploket of your gemeente (or be approached proactively after a payment-arrears signal)
Intake and debt inventory; gemeente tries an amicable settlement with creditors
If amicable settlement fails, the court can admit you to the Wsnp

documents_required.doc: Overview of debts, income and fixed costs

eligibility.income_note: No national income ceiling; the gemeente decides per case. No right to help if you reside in the Netherlands illegally; the gemeente may refuse if you are not a resident of that gemeente, used debt help before or committed fraud.

programmes.source_snippet: Voor hulp bij uw schulden kunt u zich melden bij uw gemeente. U kunt daar terecht voor een advies of een aanvraag voor schuldbemiddeling of schuldsanering.

programmes.name_en: Youth Care under the Jeugdwet (free for families)
programmes.amount_note: Free support for children under 18 and their parents: opvoedondersteuning via CJG/WIJ-teams, jeugd-ggz (accessed via the gemeente since the Jeugdwet), jeugdbescherming and jeugdzorgplus. No income test and no eigen bijdrage for families; the gemeente arranges and pays.
programmes.deadline_note: Contact the gemeente where the child lives; from 1 January 2026 the Jeugdwet changed how municipalities organise specialist youth care, but nothing changes for children and families.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the Centrum voor Jeugd en Gezin (CJG) or WIJ-team of your gemeente
The gemeente assesses the support needed and arranges a provider or a pgb

documents_required.doc: None mandatory; referral/assessment by the gemeente
