eligibility.income_note: No income test; jeugdhulp is free for the family (no eigen bijdrage).

programmes.source_snippet: Gemeenten zijn verantwoordelijk voor het beschikbaar stellen van alle vormen van jeugdhulp. Bijvoorbeeld hulp aan huis bij problemen in het gezin, maar ook bij psychische en gedragsproblemen van kinderen en jongeren.

programmes.name_en: Personal Budget for Youth Care (pgb-Jeugdwet)
programmes.amount_note: Instead of care in natura, parents of a child with a jeugdhulp indication can receive a persoonsgebonden budget from the gemeente to buy the indicated youth care themselves; the SVB pays the providers from the budget.
programmes.deadline_note: Contact the gemeente where the child lives for an indication, then apply for the PGB; the gemeente decides, then the SVB handles the care agreement and payments. A legal representative is always needed for a child.

procedure_steps.detail: Request jeugdhulp at the gemeente and ask for a pgb instead of zorg in natura
Gemeente grants the pgb; SVB administers payments to chosen providers

eligibility.income_note: No income test; budget amount follows the indicated care, not income.

programmes.source_snippet: Wilt u een persoonsgebonden budget (PGB) voor een kind aanvragen bij uw gemeente? Dat gaat via de Jeugdwet.

programmes.name_en: Free dental care for children under 18 via the basic health insurance
programmes.amount_note: Dental care for children under 18 is largely covered by the basic health insurance (check-ups, x-rays, fillings, etc.); orthodontics is not part of it. From age 18 most dental care is no longer covered.
programmes.deadline_note: Automatic via the parents' basisverzekering; the child must be co-insured with a zorgverzekeraar

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

eligibility.income_note: No income test; statutory basic-package entitlement for all insured children under 18.

programmes.source_snippet: Mondzorg voor kinderen die jonger zijn dan 18 jaar wordt grotendeels vergoed uit het basispakket van de zorgverzekering.

programmes.name_en: Amsterdam Climate Fund - home energy-saving subsidy
programmes.amount_note: Amsterdam 'Extra isolatie subsidie': up to EUR 2,500 per home for insulation, and ventilation combined with insulation, plus a bonus of up to EUR 250 for bio-based insulation; 70% paid as an advance. Only homes with WOZ value below EUR 666,000 (peiljaar 2024) and energy label D, E, F or G (or at least 2 poorly insulated building parts). Can be stacked with other subsidies up to the cost of the measure. The older 'Klimaatfonds' wording (heat pumps, HR++ glazing) is not on this page.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply before starting the work; the application must be received before 1 July 2028; activities must be finished within 1 year of the grant decision and no later than 31 December 2028. Decision within 8 weeks.

procedure_steps.detail: Check the current measures and budget via the gemeente subsidies portal
Submit the application with quotes from certified installers before starting the work

documents_required.doc: Proof of ownership or VvE mandate

eligibility.income_note: No income test; owner-occupiers of single-family homes, VvEs and VvE members in Amsterdam. An energy advice report not older than 5 years (or an energy label from 2024 or later) is required; works must be done by a professional company and not started before applying.

programmes.source_snippet: Eigenaar-bewoners van eengezinswoningen, vereniging van eigenaars (VvE's) en VvE-leden in Amsterdam kunnen per woning €2500 subsidie aanvragen voor het nemen van isolatie- en ventilatiemaatregelen.

programmes.name_en: Delftpas - leisure and school-costs pass for low-income Delft residents
programmes.amount_note: Delftpas costs EUR 5 per adult if net household income is low enough; free for children under 18 whose parents have a EUR 5 pass and for children in a Delft foster family. Free or discounted sports, culture and leisure; on the free pass the gemeente can deposit a tegemoetkoming in school costs (school and gym materials, part of the parental contribution).

procedure_steps.detail: Apply for the Delftpas at the gemeente (income test)
Use the pass at participating providers; for mbo books/materials first ask the school (schoolkostenregeling), then bijzondere bijstand if needed

eligibility.income_note: EUR 5 pass: net monthly household income up to EUR 1,682 (single) / EUR 2,403 (couple or single parent) in 2026 = EUR 20,184 / EUR 28,836 per year (x12); AOW incl. pension EUR 1,878 / 2,573 per month; self-employed annual income up to EUR 20,763 / EUR 29,661. The figure shown is the employed single-person limit.

programmes.source_snippet: Heb je een laag inkomen? En woon je in Delft? Dan kun je de Delftpas gratis of met korting krijgen. [...] Je betaalt € 5 als het gezamenlijk netto maandinkomen niet hoger is dan: € 2.403 [...] € 1.682

programmes.name_en: IOW - income provision for older unemployed workers
programmes.amount_note: Benefit for workers who were 60 or older on the first day of their WW and have fully exhausted WW (or loongerelateerde WGA): about 70% of the minimum wage for singles (per 1 July 2026 approx. EUR 76.75 bruto/day, ~EUR 1,669/month), paid until AOW age. Crucially no asset test and no partner-income test, unlike bijstand.
programmes.deadline_note: The IOW follows your WW or loongerelateerde WGA benefit and starts when that benefit reaches its maximum duration; it lasts until your AOW age. You must be at least 60 years and 4 months on your first WW/WGA day.

procedure_steps.detail: Check conditions: 60+ at start of WW, WW exhausted, wekeneis met, not yet AOW age
Apply via UWV (with DigiD) before the WW runs out

documents_required.doc: Details of WW benefit and employment history

eligibility.income_note: No household income ceiling and no asset test. UWV states explicitly that a partner's income and assets are not counted; the gross IOW benefit is 70% of the reference wage and is never higher than the sociaal minimum for a single person, with the claimant's own income offset against it.

programmes.source_snippet: Dat kan als u de AOW-leeftijd nog niet heeft bereikt en u op uw eerste WW-/WGA-dag minstens 60 jaar en 4 maanden oud was.

programmes.name_en: Municipal informal-carer appreciation (mantelzorgcompliment)
programmes.amount_note: Nearly all gemeenten offer an annual token of appreciation for registered informal carers - typically a voucher, gift card or small cash amount (often a few hundred euros), plus access to respijtzorg (respite) and mantelzorg coaching. Form and amount vary per gemeente.
programmes.deadline_note: Request it from the gemeente of the person you care for; each municipality sets its own form (amount, discount pass or free activity) and conditions.

procedure_steps.detail: Register as a mantelzorger with your gemeente or local mantelzorgmakelaar/Steunpunt Mantelzorg
The gemeente sends or offers the annual compliment and local support options

documents_required.doc: Registration as informal carer with the gemeente

eligibility.income_note: No income test; recognition-based municipal scheme for informal carers.

programmes.source_snippet: U vraagt het mantelzorgcompliment aan bij de gemeente. Gemeenten beslissen zelf over de voorwaarden en vorm van het mantelzorgcompliment.

programmes.name_en: 0% VAT on solar panels for homes
programmes.amount_note: 0% VAT (instead of 21%) on the supply and installation of solar panels on or near a home since 1 January 2023, incl. necessary cables, inverters and mounting; not on business premises without residence function, not for heat pumps/thuisbatterij/PVT, and integrated panels on a new-build home you buy are taxed at 21%.
programmes.deadline_note: Applied automatically on the installer's invoice; older situations can still reclaim via the aangifte omzetbelasting

procedure_steps.detail: No application needed — this is paid automatically to everyone who qualifies. Check that the authority holds your current address and bank details; a missing detail is the usual reason an automatic payment does not arrive.

eligibility.income_note: No income test; applies to all homeowners installing solar panels.

programmes.source_snippet: Het btw-tarief voor de levering en installatie van zonnepanelen op of bij een woning is 0%.

programmes.name_en: Free Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) for volunteers
programmes.amount_note: Free VOG for volunteers when their organisation is registered in the Regeling Gratis VOG (apply via gratisvog.nl; the organisation prepares the application in MijnJustis). Otherwise the fee is EUR 33.85 for a digital VOG and EUR 41.35 on paper. Result in 1 to 8 weeks.

procedure_steps.detail: The volunteering organisation registers with Justis for the free-VOG scheme
Volunteer completes the application; Justis screens and issues the VOG

documents_required.doc: Completed VOG application form via the organisation

eligibility.income_note: No income test; free for volunteers via registered organisations.

programmes.source_snippet: Is de organisatie waar u gaat werken aangesloten bij de Regeling Gratis VOG? Dan hoeft u niet te betalen voor de VOG-aanvraag. Anders zijn de behandelingskosten voor een digitale VOG-aanvraag € 33,85 en voor een schriftelijke VOG-aanvraag € 41,35.

programmes.name_en: OV Companion Card - free travel for a companion of a disabled traveller
programmes.amount_note: Free travel for one companion on train, metro, tram and bus; the card is in your name so you choose the companion. Applied for via Argonaut Advies (form on ov-begeleiderskaart.nl / argonaut.nl). The OV-begeleiderskaart also counts as proof for a Valys pass.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply for the OV-begeleiderskaart (via NS, with a medical statement or assessment)
Companion checks in/out with their own OV-chipkaart and travels free alongside the cardholder

documents_required.doc: Application form + medical statement of the need for a companion

eligibility.income_note: No income test; disability-based entitlement.

programmes.source_snippet: Met een OV-Begeleiderskaart reist één begeleider gratis met je mee in trein, metro, tram en bus. De kaart staat op jouw naam, dus je kiest zelf wie je meeneemt.

programmes.name_en: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship) for non-EEA students
programmes.funder: Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science / Nuffic with participating institutions
programmes.amount_note: EUR 5,000 in the first year of study; not a full-tuition scholarship
programmes.deadline_note: Applications for 2026-2027 opened 1 November 2025; check the specific closing dates on the website of the institution you apply to

procedure_steps.detail: Apply for a full-time bachelor's or master's at a participating institution
Follow the institution's NL Scholarship application instructions

eligibility.income_note: Not income-tested. Non-EEA nationality, full-time bachelor's or master's at a participating institution, no earlier degree from a Dutch institution.

programmes.source_snippet: The scholarship amounts to € 5,000. You will receive this in the first year of your studies.

programmes.name_en: Healthcare allowance (zorgtoeslag) for international students who work or have paid internships
programmes.amount_note: 2026: up to EUR 129 a month (single); phases out to nil at EUR 41,000 income. Only if you must take Dutch health insurance
programmes.deadline_note: Apply after taking out Dutch health insurance

procedure_steps.detail: Check whether you must take Dutch health insurance (e.g. you have a part-time job or a paid internship)
Take out Dutch health insurance, then apply for zorgtoeslag

eligibility.income_note: 2026: toetsingsinkomen max EUR 40,857 (single) or EUR 51,142 with toeslagpartner; asset cap EUR 146,011 / EUR 184,633. If you only study, with no job or paid internship, you stay insured in your home country and cannot get zorgtoeslag; a temporary visitor policy does not qualify.

programmes.source_snippet: Je kunt zorgtoeslag krijgen als je een Nederlandse zorgverzekering moet afsluiten. Dat moet bijvoorbeeld als je een bijbaantje hebt.

programmes.name_en: Amsterdam Merit Scholarship (University of Amsterdam, non-EU/EEA master's)
programmes.amount_note: Amount not stated on the overview page; see the UvA faculty page
programmes.deadline_note: Deadlines differ per Faculty or Graduate School

procedure_steps.detail: Apply for a UvA master's programme
Apply for the AMS via your faculty or graduate school

eligibility.income_note: Not income-tested. Requires a non-EU/EEA passport and an application to a UvA degree programme.

programmes.source_snippet: Outstanding students from outside the EU/EEA can apply for an Amsterdam Merit Scholarship (AMS).
